items.coder_A: high_grade_glioma_unspecified (uncertain: 'HGG (WHO grade III-IV)' could be historical grade IV glioma under D27C)
items.reason: Inclusion requires 'Histopathology-proven HGG (WHO grade III-IV) or DMG (WHO grade IV)': grade 4 is explicitly allowed, there is no IDH requirement and glioblastoma is never named, which is exactly the R7 pattern. Moot for the primary estimand: the only agent is a diagnostic PET tracer (S6 fails) and the phase is EARLY_PHASE1.

note: D31-B1 settles the paediatric R7 question: 'Histopathology-proven HGG (WHO grade III-IV)' is covered by D30-R7 even though paediatric, so mixed_glioma_gbm_named/historical (consistent with NCT06624371). The trial is excluded at S6 either way: 18F-fluciclovine is diagnostic_agent only, and no device or radiotherapy is under test, so no_pharmacological_candidate is kept (D31-C1). Agent moiety (priority 3): '18f-fluciclovine' (coder A). Nothing pending for XL.

revisions.reason: D31-B1 applies D30-R7 to paediatric 'HGG (WHO grade III-IV)' wording; age is handled at S4, so mixed_glioma_gbm_named/historical stands.
